note: The join policy (R+D.md §14.4, RD_14.4_HOSTILE_JOIN_PLAN.md). Named by $AT_JOIN_POLICY; absent is inert, and a file that does not validate stops the node at start. `anchors` chooses which out-of-band evidence makes an identity one this node trusts before the cohort it joins tells it anything: verified_contact (a first-contact contact whose safety number was compared, or a device its operator vouched for), zta (a credential chaining to one of our trust anchors and bound to the identity), operator (a node under THIS node's operator key: a verified operator-key binding, or a sibling device). unverified_contact is also accepted and deliberately left out here: a forwarded invitation link is enough to hold one. A class needs its extension (first_contact for contacts, zta for credentials, either for operator) or the node refuses to start. told_tier and own_evidence_min bound what the cohort's word alone can do: a peer this node holds no own evidence about reads at most told_tier until it has own_evidence_min entries of this node's own (its own halves of bilateral transactions, physics and calibration findings included), when the score built from that evidence alone takes over. An anchored peer is not bounded.
